text:
maria: Quick async check — cross-team status on the v2 rollout. Need clear owners for: /generate (gen) endpoint, embeddings endpoint, SDK 1.4.2 deprecation messaging, and a canary window this week. Current blockers I know: auth header propagation (infra), eng-ml model-compat test pass, and docs/SDK change log. Who can claim ownership for each?

alex: I can take ownership of the /generate endpoint migration and coordinate with eng-runtime. Suggest a QA canary window Fri 10:00-12:00 PST.

kevin: I'll own SDK deprecation/messaging + docs updates. Plan: draft release notes + deprecation RFC today. Proposed timeline: announce Wed, enable feature-flag in 1.4.2, soft-deprecate old param after 2 weeks of canary. I'll drop a PR for the docs.

jen: Eng-infra will own auth header propagation changes. ETA Tue EOD for LB config change, but blocker is cert rotation approval. If that goes through we can have infra changes staged Wed morning.

samir: I can help with the LB cert rotation and speed up the rollout. One ask: do we have a fallback routing policy if tokens start failing during canary? Recommend auto-route to v1 when 5xx spike > 1% for 5m.

alex: Agree on fallback. I'll add an automatic fallback rule in the canary policy. Also adding a quick smoke test to catch token header drops:
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v2/generate | jq .
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service-gen/v2 at 2024-06-12T14:04:00Z — initial 3% traffic.

kevin: Noted. I'll coordinate the SDK changelog so client teams get the deprecation notice before the canary moves to 50%. Also will prepare migration snippets for the new param names.

maria: Ownership summary: /generate -> alex; SDK deprec + docs -> kevin; infra/auth -> jen + samir; eng-ml compatibility tests -> maria (I'll run the eval harness and report failures). Canary window: Fri 10-12 PST (tentative).

maria: Action items: alex add smoke test to canary job, kevin publish draft deprecation notice by EOD, jen confirm cert rotation timeline by EOD, samir watch LB rollout and stand by. I'll update the migration board and tag owners in the runbook. :shipit:

alex: Will ping again once smoke test is green.

jen: Confirmed — cert rotation requested, awaiting approval from security.

samir: On standby. If security approves, I'll do the rotation Tue night.

maria: Thanks all. If anything changes, drop updates here or ping me directly.
